program.title: Wrestling Beginner Foundation Week 1

athlete_analysis.profile_summary: Beginner wrestler, 1 session/week, 60min gym session on Monday. Mild occasional knee discomfort on shots. 7h sleep, moderate stress. Needs safe hip/leg strength and trunk control to support wrestling mechanics without aggravating knee.
primary_constraints: Mild knee pain on shots—avoid high-impact plyometrics and landing volume
1 session/week limits volume—prioritize quality movement patterns over fatigue
Beginner wrestling skill—S&C must reinforce stance, hinge, and hip control
sport_demands: Hip extension and adductor strength for shots, sprawls, and escapes
Trunk stiffness and anti-rotation for top control and mat pressure
Relative strength for hand fighting and base stability
athlete_analysis.block_priority: Build safe strength foundation across hinge, squat, and anti-rotation patterns. Protect knee by avoiding heavy impact and high-volume shots. Establish hip and adductor capacity to support wrestling-specific actions.

weeks.theme: Wrestling S&C Foundation: Hinge, Squat, Hip Control

workouts.title: Beginner Wrestling Strength: Hinge, Squat, Hip Control
sport_transfer: Hip extension and hinge power for shots and sprawls
Trunk stiffness for top control pressure
Hip adductor and groin capacity for leg-driven wrestling actions
workouts.why_this_session: Build safe strength base for wrestling stance, shots, and escapes. Protect knees by avoiding impact while establishing posterior chain and hip control needed for beginner wrestler demands.

warmup.name: Bird Dog
warmup.purpose: Activate anti-rotation trunk stability and prepare for wrestling top pressure mechanics.

warmup.name: Dead Bug
warmup.purpose: Build supine core control and anti-extension stability without spinal load.

warmup.name: Lateral Band Walk
warmup.purpose: Activate hip abductors and lateral stability for shot mechanics and knee control.

main_work.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
main_work.purpose: Teach hip hinge pattern and build posterior chain strength for shots and sprawls.
main_work.load_guidance: Moderate weight; focus on neutral spine and hip drive, not max load
main_work.tempo: 2 sec down, pause 1 sec, 1 sec up

main_work.name: Goblet Squat
main_work.purpose: Build squat depth and knee control with front-load stability; prep for wrestling stance.
main_work.load_guidance: Dumbbell held at chest; moderate weight prioritizing depth and pain-free range
main_work.tempo: 2 sec down, 1 sec pause, 1 sec up

main_work.name: Machine Hip Adduction
main_work.purpose: Build groin and adductor strength to support wrestling actions and injury resilience.
main_work.load_guidance: Moderate weight; set machine range conservatively to avoid end-range groin stretch

main_work.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
main_work.purpose: Build glute and hip extension strength for wrestling power and mat control.
main_work.load_guidance: Dumbbell across hips; moderate load held securely
main_work.tempo: 1 sec down, pause 1 sec at top, 1 sec up

cooldown.name: Deep Squat Pry
cooldown.purpose: Restore squat-range mobility and ankle/hip opening after loaded work.

cooldown.name: Lateral Band Walk (Light)
cooldown.purpose: Deload hip abductors and build patterning stability for next session.

injury_modifications: Knee pain on shots: avoid all jumping, loaded lunges, and high-impact plyometrics; goblet squat to pain-free depth only
If knee discomfort appears, reduce goblet squat reps to 5 and increase rest to 2 min between sets
Machine adduction range set conservatively; stop 1–2 inches before full end-range to avoid groin stretch

weeks.progression_rule: Load hinge and squat patterns at RPE 6-7 (moderate effort). Use machine adduction to build groin capacity without complexity. Bird Dog and Dead Bug prepare trunk for wrestling top control. Pain-free range only on all movements.

program.nutrition_focus: Support strength adaptation and recovery between sessions: adequate protein intake (1.6–2.2 g/kg), carbohydrate around training, and consistent meal timing. Maintain hydration throughout day.
recovery_focus: Prioritize 7+ hours consistent sleep to support adaptation and wrestling learning
Use 2–3 short mobility breaks on non-training days (hip, ankle, thoracic spine)
Monitor knee response in 24–48 h post-session; reduce volume or intensity if pain increases
safety_notes: All exercises pain-free range only; stop immediately if knee discomfort exceeds mild occasional sensation
Do not perform true 1RM tests or max-effort shots in first week; establish baseline with RPE-based loading
Neutral spine required on hinge patterns; do not sacrifice form for load
Machine adduction end-range stretch should be conservative to avoid groin irritation
assumptions: Beginner wrestler has completed basic wrestling literacy (stance, motion, level change, hand fighting) or will do so in parallel wrestling practice
Knee mild discomfort is activity-related (shots, takedowns) and not acute injury; athlete has clearance to train with modifications
Gym has dumbbells, barbell, bench, machine hip adduction, and space for bodyweight drills
Sleep (7h) and moderate stress are baseline; no acute illness, concussion, or neurological symptoms
One session per week is due to schedule constraint; subsequent weeks should expand to 2–3 sessions to support wrestling progression
